newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil arrests Italians, Angolans on drug charges.
newsitem.headline: Brazil arrests Italians, Angolans on drug charges.

text.p: Brazilian police said on Wednesday they had arrested two Italians at Rio de Janeiro international airport on charges of trying to smuggle cocaine out of the country in two windsurfing boards.
The police said Claudio Nava, 36, and Flavio Moscatelli, 37, were arrested on Monday as they prepared to board a flight to Milan with boards allegedly containing 4.43 kg (9.77 pounds) of cocaine.
Rio de Janeiro police also arrested two Brazilians and an Angolan on charges of trying to smuggle a similar amount of cocaine hidden inside blankets onto a flight to Luanda on Monday.
They held an Angolan woman on the same flight who was allegedly carrying 6.48 kg (14.29 pounds) of cocaine inside boxes of car parts.
